policy: Discover and reuse matching real milestones/phase issues/PRs; this file supplies desired definitions, never fake remote IDs. One primary PR per phase. No hundreds of slice issues.

labels.name: phase

issue.title: R0 — Reconcile the repository and establish the delivery workflow
issue.body:
Plan marker: windows-alpha-recovery-2026-09-12/R0

Preserved local work, current GitHub baseline, one governing roadmap, one execution ledger, and a functioning owner-authenticated phase PR workflow.

## Slices
- [ ] R0.1 — Adopt without resetting

Minimum phase gates; README/changelog/roadmap/all-doc review; owner push and primary PR to main; actual merged/sync delivery evidence. Required live/installed final acceptance is not inferred from fixture passes.
